newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends firmer, tracking crude's gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends firmer, tracking crude's gains.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended higher, tracking firmer crude oil futures and what some traders said was background support from the coming driving season in the U.S. and higher gasoline futures.
But trading was quiet with several European holidays this week and on Monday, and end-user demand seen relatively quiet.
May swaps ended up $1.50 at $181/$182 a tonne and June finished at $183/$184. Cargoes were assessed at a slight discount, with prompt material at $178/$180 cif.
